cmd: which java; java -version 2>&1; ls /opt 2>/dev/null; find / -name "mvn" -type f 2>/dev/null | head; ls /root/.m2 2>/dev/null

ls -la /app/service; find / -name "maven*" -maxdepth 4 2>/dev/null | head; ls /usr/share/maven 2>/dev/null; apt list --installed 2>/dev/null | grep -i maven; curl -sI https://repo.maven.apache.org/mav

cd /opt && timeout 120 curl -sL -o maven.tgz https://archive.apache.org/dist/maven/maven-3/3.9.6/binaries/apache-maven-3.9.6-bin.tar.gz && tar xzf maven.tgz && ln -sf /opt/apache-maven-3.9.6/bin/mvn /
cd /app/service && timeout 600 mvn dependency:tree 2>&1 | grep -E "slf4j|logback|log4j|BUILD" | head -40
cd /app/service && timeout 300 mvn dependency:tree 2>&1 | sed -n '/maven-dependency-plugin/,$p' | grep -E "^\[INFO\] [+\\\\| ]" | head -60

cd /app/service && timeout 600 mvn clean compile 2>&1 | grep -E "ERROR|BUILD|Downloading" | tail -5 && timeout 300 mvn dependency:tree > /tmp/tree2.txt 2>&1; grep -E "slf4j|logback|log4j" /tmp/tree2.t
cd /app/service && timeout 600 mvn test 2>&1 | grep -E "Tests run|ERROR|FAIL|NoSuchMethod|SLF4J|BUILD" | head -20

cd /app/service && (timeout 60 mvn -q spring-boot:run > /tmp/run.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 45; grep -E "NoSuchMethodError|Started LoggingService|Tomcat started|ERROR" /tmp/run.log | head; curl -s -m 5 http:

cd /app/service && timeout 300 mvn -q dependency:build-classpath -Dmdep.outputFile=/tmp/cp.txt 2>&1 | tail -2; (timeout 40 java -cp target/classes:$(cat /tmp/cp.txt) com.example.service.LoggingService

grep -iE "SLF4J: (Class path|Actual|Failed)" /tmp/run.log | head -3; cd /app/service && timeout 600 mvn clean compile test 2>&1 | grep -E "Tests run:|BUILD" | tail -3 && timeout 300 mvn dependency:tre
